scope: Actual chat module in isolated Node VM with minimal fake DOM plus template/style assertions; not browser rendering.
exit_code_provenance: Observed successful exec result for the real runner; this report is a later wrapper around its unchanged stdout log, not native runner JSON.

cases.name: network failure preserves the exact text and prepared image
HTTP error preserves draft and reuses idempotency key on retry
success clears only the sent draft, not newly typed text
paste inserts plain text with tabs, spaces and normalized line breaks
render contract uses pre-wrap and tab-size without the 5MB gate
delete, clear, reset and stale revisions apply consistently
composer removes the permanent hints rather than hiding functional controls
mobile rename moves to the top bar before binding the shared desktop action
missing image decoder still disables uploads without a help element
SSE reconnect and polling fallback do not need a visible status element
